title: Report of awareness program on consequences of consuming the Tobacco
content:
Report of awareness program on consequences of consuming the Tobacco 

With respect to the above-mentioned subject, .1 would like to bring your kind notice that, an awareness program to the students on Tobacco in association with Red FM-93.5 Mysuru, has been organized on 5th' May 2025 (Thursday) from 11.00.AM to 11.30AM, in front of College Cafeteria.

The program was conducted for the first year students of all branches. The resource person for the event was a well-known medical practitioner Dr.Vidya, Radiation Anthologist Narayana Multi specialist hospital Mysuru, This program was educated the students about the consequences of consuming the Tobacco. More than 500 students from first year were educated from this event.
